title: Oracle shadow configuration
statement: Given $n\geq 0$, an index $i<n$, a Boolean input string $x$, a configuration of an $n$-work-tape machine on $x$ with state set $S$, and a Boolean $b$, define a configuration with $n+1$ work tapes and state set $S\times\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. Pair each present state with $b$; preserve the input-head position and output; append to the work tapes the tape containing true only at position $0$; and set the added work-tape head position equal to that of tape $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is an index among the $n$ work tapes
$x$ is a finite Boolean input string
$c$ is a configuration with $n$ work tapes and state set $S$
